A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same inference-aware fine-tuning study and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. Relocated proof material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix D report original Gemma fine-tuning experiments, mathematical reasoning and code-generation evaluations, and inference-scaling analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including Gemma evaluations on mathematical reasoning and code generation.

M1.justification: Lemma 3 changes the stated BoN-RLB failure-sample contribution from subtraction to addition, although Algorithm 3 retains subtraction. Equation (7) also restores a gradient contribution already represented through ∇f in v1's Algorithm 4. These are localized revisions to the stated updates; an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MATH and MBPP training coverage and MATH, Functional MATH, MathOdyssey, and HumanEval evaluations. The held-out, temperature-transfer, and verifier-mismatch scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: base models, standard SFT, RL-V/RL-S, and STaR remain, as do the Base-BoN-SFT, Base-All-SFT, Base-Weighted-SFT, and Base-Maj-SFT comparisons in Figure 14.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation settings remain unchanged, including Gemma 2B/9B configurations, the 500-problem MATH evaluation split, BoN/pass@N metrics, and sampling sweeps. Table 2 retains 2,500 training steps and batch size 32; no new evaluation protocol is reported.

E4.justification: The co-scaling analyses, training-sample and evaluation-temperature sweeps, held-out generalization tests, and verifier-mismatch analysis are retained. Figures 5b, 8–10, 13, and 15 provide the same supplementary evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate plots, fitting summaries, and Monte Carlo estimation description. Neither introduces repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The experimental curves and tabulated results match throughout. Both report the same Gemma 2B MATH Bo32 comparison—26.8% for the base model versus 30.8% for BoN-RL-V—and HumanEval pass@16 comparison—61.6% versus 67.1% for BoN-RLB(P).

T1.justification: Two central policy-gradient results are substantively revised. Lemma 2 and Appendix A.3 retain the win-rate derivative omitted in v1, replacing the invalid claim that every BoN draw has win-rate one with the zero-mean score identity. Lemma 3 and Appendices A.4–A.5 also reverse the failure-term sign.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: inference-aware SFT/RL, temperature–sample co-scaling, implicit exploration, and improved BoN/pass@N performance. Their claimed scope and headline empirical comparisons are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of exploration, verifier errors, generalization, sample inefficiency, and training instability remain unchanged. In particular, Section 4 still explains learning through reducing incorrect-response likelihood despite the revised sign in Lemma 3.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same pseudocode, optimizer settings, KL schedule, value estimation, and clipping details. Appendix D.2 retains the same data-generation and verifier-training information. No new implementation, hardware, code, or data-access information is supplied.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the references retain the same cited works and positioning relative to STaR/ReST, BoN distillation, self-correction, and search. No research-positioning expansion or citation addition/removal is evident.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to local proof prose, several cross-references changing from 'Appendix' to 'Section', and the version stamp. The main narrative, terminology, and section organization are preserved.

P2.justification: Figures 1–15 and Tables 1–3 retain their displays and numbering. Equation (7) expands to two lines, and Appendix A.4 moves from page 19 to page 20. Minor typesetting changes include a footer-rule overlap with text on v2 page 22.

improvement.justification: v2 improves mathematical reliability by repairing Lemma 2's omitted derivative and invalid win-rate argument, and revising the binary-gradient signs consistently across Lemma 3 and its proofs. The benefit is limited by incomplete propagation: Algorithm 3 still subtracts the failure term, and the accompanying explanation is unchanged. The retained experiments do not clarify which update generated the reported results.
